Michiko Fleuretty is a "Devil" girl and main character in Witch of Steel Annerose and loyal to Annerose Vajra.

Unlike normal demons, she is from the Otherworld and not Demon Realm.

Right! Normally, for an otherworldly being to stabilize their presence in this world...They'd already be using a ton of power. It's the same for me, but normally you'd be at half power.
Michiko Fleuretty

Personality
She acts pleasant when Annerose is around, but is very rude and antagonizing to anyone else. Michiko can be downright cruel to certain people, as long as they don't die.

She is a bit of a tsundere and blushes easily, but also is completely unskilled as a maid and servant, failing the most basic tasks of cooking or cleaning. Spending most of her time sleeping to remain in form. It is mentioned she has a terrible sense of time and often wakes people up to early or way to late. Her cooking, is so terrible it basically just wastes food and if she cleans the house often just becomes more dirty.

She detests her brethren of the Otherworld and loves the Human World, wishing to protect it. She wishes to be called Michiko and gets angry if called Fleuretty which is her true name from that side, she also dislikes being reminded of her true form as a Black Dragon, as she is more of a "swallowtail butterfly" in her own mind. Michiko is in love with Annerose, and hates anyone that peeks her mistress's interest. It is mentioned that Otonashi Miki was also her type. Michiko's feelings of jealousy often causes conflicts between her and Tachibana Rikurou, as Michiko doesn't want to lose her place as Annerose's “favorite servant”.

Outside Annerose, she respects Neu Eazlane but will be rude to basically everyone else or begin random fights with them. She mocks often humans but also insults most demons and even spirits.

Appearance
Michiko is using the form of a woman with short bright green hair and violet eyes.

She is described as a Black Dragon in her true form.

History
Background
Michiko is the maid, friend and bodyguard of the Witch, Annerose Vajra, and works for her Detective Agency in Amidahara.

While resembling a human to impress Annerose, most assume she is a strange demon, as she is able to transform into a suitcase, which Annerose often carries around. Despite her looking like a maid, she is terrible when it comes to cleaning and cooking. Why she works with Annerose is a secret, and both are under some form of "contract".

In reality, she is a being of the "Otherworld", a realm different to Demon Realm and Human World, the home of Spirits and Gods. She was a subject of the Demon Lord Beelzebub and one of the six superior spirits. Her name Fleuretty is her true name, and Michiko was given to her by Annerose Vajra. Her true form is never shown, but she is extremely powerful and a Black Dragon, but in order to remain in the human realm, she is forced to reduce her own strength.

Annerose and Michiko are in some kind of contract that keeps Michiko's identity save, with only characters like Neu Eazlane aware, but their shared past is a current unknown.

Powers/Abilities
Main Weapon: Axes

Shapeshifting: Can shape-shift into human form or into a suitcase or into a human.
Magic: Darkness and Ice Magic
Dragon Form: Her true form is that of a large flying black dragon.
